method_note: 504 rows, all labelled 'nasdaq calendar'. 26 were checked and 478 were not. How the 26 were chosen: domestic small and mid caps ($0.1-20bn) with heavy retail turnover and wide historical reactions, where something unpriced has room to exist and matter, split across both sessions (amc 2026-11-04: SEZL BYND LEU ROOT WOLF FSLY CHYM RUN FIG ELF JOBY CAVA, plus DAVE HUBS SNAP unconfirmed; bmo 2026-11-05: LMND OSCR NVAX PTON CELH CORZ EOSE U TRIP SHAK, plus WRBY unconfirmed). Skipped on purpose: mega and large caps with deep coverage (ARM QCOM MCK APP MELI and so on), utilities, BDCs and closed-end or income vehicles (OBDC OTF FSK OXLC MFIC TCPC CION TPVG MCN), duplicate share classes (FWONA/FWONK, NWS/NWSA, Z/ZG, LILA/LILAK, GLIBA/GLIBK, KELYA/KELYB), and sub-$200m names likely under the turnover floor. NOT VERIFIED: (1) turnover from the baselines. Only SEZL's baseline was read (avg volume 494k at about $139, about $68m a day); the rest are judged liquid from general knowledge, and BYND, with a $125m cap, needs a turnover check. (2) event_plausibility for every name except SEZL. baseline_history_trustworthy is false for SEZL (the baseline says so) and EOSE (pre-release 8-K 2.02s exist); for the rest it is set true without inspection. (3) Most confirmations are company press releases read through reprints or search relays (finviz/Business Wire, GlobeNewswire on morningstar, investingnews, itiger, placera), not the IR pages themselves. Company-hosted sources were used for CHYM (chime.com), ELF (investor.elfbeauty.com), CELH (q4cdn IR PDF), JOBY (ir.jobyaviation.com) and EOSE (SEC 8-K). SHAK and PTON rest on aggregators relaying the company notice. FIG's hour is not settled from the Q3 release, though every prior call was 5 pm ET. (4) Short interest was looked up only for LMND and BYND, and both figures are stale; every other name is 'unknown'. (5) trades_on is 'unknown' unless a dated source tied a reaction to one line (PTON only). No directional view is formed.
